subject: Intermittent inference errors — retention variance request for debugging
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lumina.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, support@redwood.ai
Cc: secops@lumina.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Intermittent inference errors — request for logs retention beyond standard window

Hi Karthik / Redwood support,

We're seeing intermittent model failures in our production flows (session ids attached in the snippet) starting Feb 26 that stop after a few hours and then reappear. Our SREs need the raw request/response logs and KV cache traces for the affected sessions to reproduce the issue.

Current retention for these debug traces appears to have expired — can Redwood make an exception and extend retention for the affected sessions by 7 days (or at least 72 hours) so we can capture traces for post-mortem? We understand this is out of standard policy and are happy to sign any authorization you require.

Attached: lumina_debug_snippet_0228.txt (small extract, session ids obfuscated)

Thanks — this is blocking a customer rollout.

—
Ellen Park
Head of SRE
Lumina Analytics
ellen.park@lumina.ai
+1 415-555-0112
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lumina.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent inference errors — request for logs retention beyond standard window

Monica / Vivek / Markus — looping you in. Lumina is asking for a temporary retention variance to preserve debug traces for sessions that fell out of our standard window. They indicate this is blocking a rollout.

Key asks from customer:
- Retain request/response logs + KV cache traces for listed session ids (attached)
- Window: prefer 7 days, minimum 72 hours
- Region: us-west (their traffic is pinned there)

Can security confirm what approvals we need and what controls (ACLs, separate bucket, audit logs) we must apply before granting a short-term exception? Engineering: can infra create a time-limited snapshot and restrict access to the small SOC/SE team?

I want this handled as an exception (not policy change) with explicit scope and automatic deletion after the window. Ellen — can you confirm you’ll sign off on the temporary retention and that your SecOps will accept the audit trail we capture?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0199
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lumina.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intermittent inference errors — request for logs retention beyond standard window

Thanks for the ping, Karthik. I reviewed the minimal ask and attached a short excerpt of the retention policy for reference.

High-level: security can approve a temporary, scoped exception if the following controls are in place:
- Timebox: maximum 72 hours unless escalated with documented business justification (we should prefer 72 over 7 days for faster approval)
- Scope: only session ids listed in lumina_debug_snippet_0228.txt; no bulk access to unrelated customer data
- Access controls: logs must be stored in a separate encrypted bucket with ACLs restricted to two named Redwood engineers + Lumina SecOps; no broad team access
- Audit: every access event must be logged and exported to our audit workspace (retain for 1 year)
- Customer acknowledgment: Lumina must reply to this thread explicitly accepting the controls and timeframe

If Lumina agrees, we will open SUP-7421 and attach the signed exception records. Engineering, can you confirm feasibility (time to snapshot, expected size, who will be added to ACL)?

Attachment: retention_policy_excerpt.pdf

—
Monica Patel
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lumina.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent inference errors — request for logs retention beyond standard window

Quick implementation plan:
- We can create an encrypted snapshot of the affected logs and place them in a time-limited S3 bucket (lifecycle rule to expire + delete after 72 hours) linked to the SUP-7421 ticket.
- Required actions from customer: explicit reply to this thread approving the controls; staff emails for ACL (we will add two engineer principals and one Lumina SecOps address by email)
- Estimated time: 2–3 hours to snapshot + ACLs, additional 30 mins to verify audit trails are being collected
- Rollback: automatic deletion triggered at expiry; we’ll run the delete job and post the audit records to the ticket.

Security note: we will redact any PII where possible prior to snapshot, but to debug KV cache issues we may need raw traces. Monica — please confirm redaction guidance.

Markus
Sr. Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lumina.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intermittent inference errors — request for logs retention beyond standard window

Ellen — thanks for the quick report. Per Monica and Markus we can proceed with a scoped 72-hour retention exception under the controls below. Please reply-all to this thread with a single-line approval so we have an in-thread customer sign-off to attach to SUP-7421.

Scope & controls (summary):
- Data: request/response logs + KV cache traces for session ids in lumina_debug_snippet_0228.txt only
- Window: 72 hours from snapshot completion
- Access: ACLs limited to Markus K. and one Redwood SRE (to be named) + Lumina SecOps (secops@lumina.ai)
- Audit: every access logged and attached to SUP-7421
- Deletion: automatic, verified by audit, with post-delete confirmation to this thread

If you approve, we’ll start the snapshot immediately (ETA 2–3 hours).

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
